I recently visited Zudio at Mira Bhayander. The store is neat, clean, and well-maintained. The layout is good, and the items are arranged properly, which makes shopping comfortable. Prices are reasonable and affordable, especially for everyday clothing.

However, the collection is quite limited, and there are very few options compared to other Zudio stores. I expected a better variety in clothes, footwear, and accessories. Because of the limited collection, it becomes difficult to find trendy or different styles.

The staff was polite, and the billing process was smooth and quick. Overall, the store is suitable for quick and simple shopping. It is a good option if you need basic clothing at budget-friendly prices, but there is definitely scope for improvement in terms of variety and collection.
